```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, roster_pos) |> label_endings()
study_pop <- filter(endings, group != "Position not recorded")
state_fill <- ending_palette()
hz_lab <- c(drafted = "Drafted", signed_udfa = "Signed undrafted")
# Too few players at risk make a per-season rate noise.
min_risk <- 500
min_curve <- 30
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
hz_all <- ending_hazards(study_pop, by = NULL) |>
  filter(ending %in% names(hz_lab), at_risk >= min_risk)
hz_wide <- hz_all |>
  select(time, ending, hazard) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = hazard)
cross_season <- min(hz_wide$time[hz_wide$signed_udfa > hz_wide$drafted])

p <- ggplot(hz_all, aes(time, 100 * hazard, colour = hz_lab[ending])) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = cross_season - 0.5, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#7570B3", alpha = 0.08) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.8) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "All positions, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s of %s at risk)",
        time, pct(hazard), tolower(hz_lab[ending]), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(events), fmt(at_risk)
      ),
      data_id = paste(ending, time)
    ),
    size = 3.4
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = state_fill[c("Drafted", "Signed undrafted")]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = hz_wide$time) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Per-season chance of each NFL route",
    subtitle = "Of players still playing going into each eligible season; shaded where signing undrafted leads",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Chance that season",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "nfl-route-chance-by-season", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-position
ci <- ending_incidence(endings) |> filter(group != "Position not recorded")
thin <- thin_position_groups(ci, 3L, min_curve)
hz_group <- ending_hazards(study_pop) |>
  filter(ending %in% names(hz_lab), at_risk >= min_curve, !group %in% thin) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, position_group_levels()))
p_group <- hz_group |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s of %s at risk)",
      group, time, pct(hazard), tolower(hz_lab[ending]), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(events), fmt(at_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * hazard, colour = hz_lab[ending])) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, ending, time)), size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = state_fill[c("Drafted", "Signed undrafted")]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(max(hz_group$time))) +
  labs(
    title = "Each position's per-season chance of each NFL route",
    subtitle = "Of players still playing going into each eligible season, the share drafted or signed undrafted that season",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Share that season (%)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Seasons with fewer than ", min_curve, " players at risk are omitted.",
      if (length(thin)) paste0(" Omitted groups: ", paste(tolower(thin), collapse = ", "), ".") else "",
      " Hover a point for its interval and counts."
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_group, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-era
# The era split comes from the draft-outcome cards' eligible seasons (one row
# per season, not per player), where each season carries its draft class.
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes")))
y0 <- min(risk$draft_year)
y1 <- max(risk$draft_year)
hazard_era <- risk |>
  mutate(
    era = cut(
      draft_year,
      breaks = c(y0 - 1, 2016, 2021, y1),
      labels = c(
        sprintf("%d to 2016 classes", y0),
        "2017 to 2021 classes",
        sprintf("2022 to %d classes", y1)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(era, eligible_season_index) |>
  summarise(seasons = n(), p = mean(outcome_nfl_entry_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(seasons >= 100)
p_era <- ggplot(hazard_era, aes(eligible_season_index, p, colour = era)) +
  geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = era, tooltip = era), linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = era,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, eligible season %d: %.1f%% entered the NFL (%s seasons)",
        era,
        eligible_season_index,
        100 * p,
        fmt(seasons)
      )
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(hazard_era$eligible_season_index)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Per-season chance of NFL entry, by era of draft classes",
    subtitle = "Drafted or signed undrafted, by eligible season number",
    x = "Eligible season number",
    y = "Chance that season",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Counts eligible seasons rather than players. Era and season cells with fewer than 100 seasons omitted. Hover a line to isolate an era."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_era)
```
